[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra II.15 (Sādhanapāda) — sarvaṃ vivekinaḥ | Pages 430-439]

āmaprāptaṃ tāpaduḥkhaṃ vyākhyātuṃ pṛcchati-- atha keti / Tāpo duḥkhaṃ kiṃ tāpajanya-
duḥkhasāmānyam ity arthaḥ / Uttaram-- sarvasyeti / Pūrvavad eva vyākhyeyam. Pūrvaṃ
sukhānubhavo rāgānuviddha uktaḥ, idānīṃ ca duḥkhānubhavo dveṣānuviddha ucyata ity eva viśeṣa
iti / (-)
Kramaprāptaṃ saṃskāraduḥkhaṃ pṛcchati-- kā punar iti / Sukhaduḥkhasaṃskārajanyaduḥkha-
sāmānyam ity arthaḥ / Sukhānubhavād iti / Atreyaṃ prakriyā-- ādau sukhaduḥkhānubhavais
tatsaṃskārāśayo'nudbuddhasaṃskāras tataḥ kālādiviśeṣais tadudbodhas tataḥ smṛtis tato rāgadveṣau
tayoś ca pravṛttiḥ, tataś ca punar duḥkham iti /
Y
